review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — The first test in docs-only-ui.test.ts routes a card touching only README.md with front-end wording and asserts ui is absent and the proof is not ui-screenshots.
- A2: met — The test routes docs/guide.md plus src/app/main.ts and asserts ui, a11y and ui-screenshots. It checks the outcome, not equality with the old routing, but it is adequate.
- A3: met — The test routes a card with empty touches and asserts ui, a11y and ui-screenshots. `docsOnly` requires a non-empty touch list, so this card routes as before.

<details><summary>1 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Bare `continue` skips the rest of the sector's loop body, with no comment saying why `packages/runtime/src/router/route.ts:199` — Wrap the keyword loop in `if (wordsScore(sector)) { ... }` instead of continuing, and add a one-line comment on `docsOnly` saying a Markdown-only card is routed on its touches, not its wording.

</details>

_claude-sonnet-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: Bare `continue` skips the rest of the sector's loop body, with no comment saying why
suggestions.detail: `if (!wordsScore(sector)) continue;` leaves the per-sector loop after the path score. If any code after the keyword loop in that body later scores something other than words (for example a flag or profile signal), docs-only cards will silently lose it for ui. The surrounding code explains each scoring rule in a comment, and `docsOnly` and `isDocsTouch` have none.
suggestions.fix: Wrap the keyword loop in `if (wordsScore(sector)) { ... }` instead of continuing, and add a one-line comment on `docsOnly` saying a Markdown-only card is routed on its touches, not its wording.

acceptance.note: The first test in docs-only-ui.test.ts routes a card touching only README.md with front-end wording and asserts ui is absent and the proof is not ui-screenshots.
The test routes docs/guide.md plus src/app/main.ts and asserts ui, a11y and ui-screenshots. It checks the outcome, not equality with the old routing, but it is adequate.
The test routes a card with empty touches and asserts ui, a11y and ui-screenshots. `docsOnly` requires a non-empty touch list, so this card routes as before.
